instruction: Get the Breeze cursor theme from gnome-look.org and use it on your GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate to gnome-look.org, download and install Breeze cursor theme, then apply it through GNOME settings. Evaluator checks if cursor-theme setting contains 'Breeze'. Similar difficulty to original GTK theme task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: postconfig executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-theme' which properly reads the currently applied cursor theme setting
Result extraction is correct: cache_file getter reads the gsettings output from the correct file path
Metric logic is correct: check_list function properly verifies if 'Breeze' pattern appears in the cursor theme setting using regex matching
Coverage is complete: evaluator verifies the final outcome (Breeze theme applied) which correctly validates task completion
Expected value is semantically correct: 'Breeze' matches the actual cursor theme name that should be applied
Data flow is correct: postconfig command -> cache file -> check_list metric works seamlessly
Practical feasibility confirmed: gsettings command works in GNOME environment and regex pattern will match the output format
